abstract: The host tissue reaction to choriocarcinoma was studied in 81 Nigerian patients. A mononuclear cellular reaction, observed in about 42 per cent of the patients, was composed mainly of lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes, and eosinophils in varying quantities around tumor deposits. No correlation was found between the survival of the patients and the intensity of the cellular reaction. Late presentation by our patients for medical advice and treatment may partly account for the relatively poor response to chemotherapy. The syncytiotrophoblast appears to play a primary role in vascular invasion by the neoplastic trophoblast.
abstract_ja: ナイジェリアの81例の患者において、絨毛癌に対する宿主組織反応を検討した。患者の約42%で認められた単核細胞反応は、腫瘍巣周囲においてリンパ球、形質細胞、組織球、好酸球を主体とし、その量はさまざまであった。単核細胞反応の強さと患者生存との間に相関は認められなかった。患者の受診・治療開始が遅いことが、化学療法への比較的乏しい反応の一因と考えられる。合胞体栄養膜細胞が、腫瘍性栄養膜細胞の血管浸潤において主要な役割を果たすと考えられる。
